cases.source:
ka kasa_schema_unique([])
ka kasa_record_shape_valid([], [])
ka kasa_record_shape_valid([], [1])

ma fields = ["id", "name", "amount"]
ma record = [101, "Ama", 2500]
ka kasa_record_shape_valid(fields, record)
ka kasa_field_or(fields, record, "name", "missing")
ka kasa_field_or(fields, record, "amount", -1)

ma fields = ["id", "name"]
ka kasa_record_shape_valid(fields, [1])
ka kasa_record_shape_valid(fields, [1, "Ama", 30])
ka kasa_field_or(fields, [1], "id", -1)

ma fields = ["id", "id"]
ma record = [10, 20]
ka kasa_record_shape_valid(fields, record)
ka kasa_field_or(fields, record, "id", -1)

ma fields = ["name", "amount"]
ka kasa_required_field_present(fields, ["Ama", 0], "amount")
ka kasa_required_field_present(fields, ["Ama", hwee], "amount")

ma fields = ["id", "note"]
ka kasa_field_or(fields, [1, hwee], "note", "none")
ka kasa_required_field_present(fields, [1, hwee], "note")

ma names = ["id", "name"]
ma record = [7, "Kofi"]
ka kasa_field_or(names, record, "name", "?")
ka names[0]
ka record[0]
ka tentɛn(record)
